description: Read the user's latest X (Twitter) bookmarks as typed data (text, author, metrics, media, links, quoted posts, articles) with a TypeScript SDK that calls X's Bookmarks GraphQL API via fetch inside the signed-in x.com tab through playwriter. Use when the user asks for their bookmarks, saved tweets, or wants to export, summarize, or process X bookmarks.
